run_eval_lm_perplexity: run the eval_lm CLI to evaluate perplexity of a trained language model on a dataset
run_eval_lm_word_stats: run eval_lm with output_word_stats to print word-level probability statistics sorted by count
run_eval_lm_word_probs: run eval_lm with output_word_probs to print per-word log probabilities for each sample
review_WordStat_class: review the WordStat class that tracks word log probabilities, next word probabilities, and occurrence counts
review_main_eval_lm: review the main function that loads models, scores sequences, and computes average NLL loss and perplexity
